title: Madison police union addresses Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway in response to mental health blog
text: Madison’s police union addressed Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway about her “Mental Health and Emergency Response” blog. Madison Professional Police Officers Association President Kelly Powers said in a letter to the mayor that her comments cause significant concern for the union’s members,…
